web.title: Sacra Corona Unita
web.description:
Sacra Corona Unita

## Activities
Originally preying on the region's substantial wine and olive oil industries, the group moved into [cigarette smuggling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cigarette_smuggling), arms trafficking, drug trafficking, [human trafficking](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_trafficking), [money laundering](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Money_laundering), extortion, and [political corruption](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Political_corruption).

## Structure
This money is then laundered into countries across Europe, such as the U.K., Spain, and Germany.

## Alliances of Sacra Corona Unita
### Balkan organizations
The [Albanian mafia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albanian_mafia) collaborates with the SCU to make Albania a sorting centre for large amounts of smuggled cigarettes, and [drugs from Afghanistan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drug_trafficking), much of which enter Italy through the coasts of Montenegro, Croatia and Albania.
